title: Resume Layout Overrides
description: Bounded layout knobs the tailoring agent may adjust. Defaults are the tight one-page baseline (10.0pt body; 0.4in horizontal / 0.3in vertical margins) proven to fit a full history; a caller may loosen up toward 11pt / 0.6in for lighter content. Ranges define how far the render pipeline will let a caller push font size and margins.

font_size_pt.description: Body text size in points. 10.0 is the readability floor and the default (fits a full history on one page); loosen toward 11.0 for lighter content.

margin_h_in.description: Horizontal page margin (left AND right) in inches. This sets line length / measure, so its floor stays at 0.4in — 0.4 is the practical floor (most printers can't print closer to the edge) and the default; loosen toward 0.6 for lighter content.

margin_v_in.description: Vertical page margin (top AND bottom) in inches. Only trades vertical whitespace (not line length), so it floors lower at 0.3in; 0.3 is the default. Loosen toward 0.6 for lighter content.
